asset_missing: No such file in the loaded packs: %s
target.no_matches: No target by that name. Targets are added to the rig as attachments.
colliders.all: All colliders on this bone, including ones added later
colliders.none_on_bone: This bone has no colliders, so there is nothing to make this of. Add a collider to the bone first.
animate: Animate on the timeline: the field takes a key where the playhead is
locked_by_timeline: The timeline writes this field; turn on recording keys on the timeline to change it
stop_animating: Stop animating: the keys go and the field takes its own value again
nothing_selected: Select something to see its parameters
